notes.title: update to V1.04
notes.notes: Patch 1.04 overhauled the UI for equipping weapons and fix some other small UI issues

notes.title: V 1.00 to V 1.03
notes.notes:
Over the last few days I have put out three small patches, V1.01 stop the camera going out of the map boundaries. However this patch broke the physics of moving the ships so patch 1.02 fix these broken system. Patch 1.03 fix some UI issues. 

More details[list]
[*]Stop camera from going out of the map boundaries
[*]Fixed physics of moving ships (V1.01 broke this), and improved by adjusting the forces so ships move faster and take less time to turn around
[*]Fix asteroids collision bug were the collision volume would detach from the mesh (V1.01 broke this)
[*]Fixed bug were weapons were not displaying in the fleet manager
[*]Fixed bug were fleet manager would display incorrect information after skipping the tutorial 
[*]Miss clicking close to UI will no longer cause a ships to move
[*]Fixed achievement first win, previously it would give this achievement out if you win or lose a level  
[*]Fixed spelling mistake in the tutorial
[*]UI changed from strength and spawning to next wave strength and now spawning wave with strength
[/list]
